note: Evidence-based WebR package compatibility. EVERY status here comes from actually running the package in real WebR (probe via the headless-WebR harness), never from guessing. The per-lesson runner Scripts/verify_lesson_webr.mjs is the ground truth for a lesson's actual code; this registry is the fast hint the gate + /write-lesson consult. To add or change an entry, PROBE the package in WebR and record the evidence. Statuses: runnable = runs and produces real output (use a live ```r block); runnable_no_visual = runs without error but its rich HTML/widget output does NOT render in WebR (use ```r for the data/text but show the visual as a static image, or mark ```r-static); illustrative = library loads but the lesson's actual use needs a server / API key / network and cannot execute (use ```r-static); incompatible = errors in WebR (do not run; switch package or ```r-static).

dplyr.evidence: filter()/summarise() run; output 118 rows on iris

ggplot2.evidence: ggplot()+geom_point() builds AND print(p) renders headless with no error

data.table.evidence: RUNS single-threaded; set setDTthreads(1); dt[, .(m=mean(x)), by=g] works

gt.evidence: gt() builds a gt_tbl without error, but the styled HTML table does not render in WebR; show the plain print() or pair a static image

gtsummary.evidence: tbl_summary() builds without error; output is gt/HTML, will not render in WebR

flextable.evidence: flextable() builds without error; rich output does not render in WebR

kableExtra.evidence: kbl() returns a kableExtra object; HTML styling does not render in WebR

plotly.evidence: plot_ly() builds a plotly object without error, but the interactive chart does not render in WebR; pair a static image or use a built ggplot

leaflet.evidence: leaflet() builds without error; the map widget does not render in WebR

DT.evidence: datatable() builds without error; the interactive table widget does not render in WebR

crosstalk.evidence: SharedData$new() runs, but linked-view output is an htmlwidget that does not render in WebR

shiny.evidence: library loads (runApp is a function) but an app cannot serve inside WebR; show app code as r-static

ellmer.evidence: library loads (chat_openai is a function) but a live chat needs an API key + network; show the call as r-static

ranger.evidence: ranger::ranger() ERRORS in WebR; use randomForest (runnable) instead
